answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 91 keys loses far more than 91 single identities would. The tide graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the sonnet audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the vine checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
